subject: Post-call: Performance qualification & benchmark method (ClearSight Analytics)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Performance qualification & benchmark method (ClearSight Analytics)

Evan — thanks for the deep dive today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have shared expectations before the benchmark window.

Summary of what we heard / agreed:
- Target user flow: real-time transcript enrichment + sentiment annotation for live monitoring (avg payload ~1.2k tokens).
- Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end token completion <= 150ms for single-turn calls; p50 first-byte streaming <= 80ms.
- Throughput / concurrency: baseline throughput target 300 req/s sustained with bursts to 900 req/s during spikes; expected concurrency per instance ~6–10.
- Streaming: chunked streaming required; connection-level keep-alives and mid-stream cancellation support needed.

Benchmark methodology (proposed):
1) Prompt sets: you provide a representative bundle (we discussed you uploading ~500 real traces). We will also run a synthetic set (~1k) that emphasizes worst-case token lengths.
2) Harness: Redwood will run the benchmark in your staging region using our evaluation harness (we'll share the Drive folder).
3) Measurement defs: we measure first-byte latency, token-append latency, p50/p95/p99 for both single-turn and streaming flows. We’ll also report tail jitter and throughput over sliding 1-minute windows.
4) Repro steps: we’ll snapshot model version, runtime config (quantization/batching), and seed the harness with the same prompt file. We’ll provide a dockerized harness and the command-lines used for runs.

Requests / asks for ClearSight (action items):
- Upload: clearsight_prompt_bundle_v1.jsonl (anonymized) to the Drive folder by Nov 4.
- Provide staging credentials + a short-lived test API key for the benchmark environment.
- Confirm any IP allowlists or region constraints for Nov 8–9 test window.

Internal asks (cc’ed): Ben / Laura — please review the SLOs above and confirm the run plan (I propose two runs: steady-state throughput test + streaming-first-byte stress test). Ben — can your team prepare the harness instructions and attach the mvp-slo-matrix? Laura — please coordinate the engineering time for the Nov 8 run window.

Attachments referenced: clearsight_prompt_bundle_v1.jsonl (placeholder), benchmark-harness-instructions.pdf, mvp-slo-matrix.xlsx.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m alignment if you want to walk through the runs before we kick off.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@clearsight.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance qualification & benchmark method (ClearSight Analytics)

Thanks, Jasmine — this is super clear. A couple clarifications from our side:

- We can get you ~420 anonymized transcripts (will strip PII) by Nov 4.
- Our staging is in us-west-2; we’ll create a scoped API key for the Redwood harness (no egress limits).
- For streaming, we care most about first-byte under 60ms for our live alerting use case. If 80ms is the reasonable engineering target for initial pass, please flag to us where to iterate.
- On concurrency: most users will be 4–8 concurrent streams, but we do have occasional spikes to 16.

We’re happy to move forward with Nov 8–9. One note from procurement — we’ll need a short statement of expected test hours and a temporary non-production SLA during the run so we can clear the IP and ops approvals. I’ll loop in procurement in the next message.

—Evan
Evan Cho
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearSight Analytics
evan.cho@clearsight.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@clearsight.ai>
Date: 2027-11-04T18:27:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Performance qualification & benchmark method (ClearSight Analytics)

Ben / Laura — Evan confirmed the prompt bundle timeline and gave more stringent first-byte streaming target (60ms). He also noted spike concurrency to 16.

New / updated QA items for the run:
- Add a streaming-first-byte test with a 60ms objective (we’ll measure success rates and provide a breakdown by model variant).
- Ensure harness can simulate spikes to 16 concurrent streams and sustained 300 req/s baseline.
- Prepare a short one-paragraph test-hours statement for procurement: we estimate 6 hours of active benchmarking across two days (Nov 8 morning + Nov 9 morning PST), with an additional 4 hours of log collection/analysis.

Action owners:
- Ben: attach the benchmark-harness-instructions.pdf and a one-paragraph test-hours statement. Also include the exact CLI we’ll run so ClearSight can replay if needed.
- Laura: reserve the Nov 8–9 engineering window and confirm team availability.

I’ll confirm the Drive upload once we see the prompt bundle.

—
Jasmine
